scenarios.starting_prompt: We are noticing latency spikes on our Cloud SQL Postgres instance '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_INSTANCE}' in project '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_PROJECT}'. Can you check the CPU utilization and memory usage over the last 15 minutes to see if we are hitting resource limits?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user observes that CPU and memory look normal, but clients report connection errors. Ask the agent to check the number of active database connections and whether connections have spiked. Once connection metrics are reported, end the conversation. Success Criteria: the assistant queries CPU/memory metrics and active connection metrics using get_system_metrics for the specified project and instance. Failure Criteria: the assistant invents or guesses metric values without calling get_system_metrics, or queries the wrong instance.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Our batch job is running slower than expected on instance '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_INSTANCE}' in project '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_PROJECT}'. Check Query Insights to identify which queries have the highest execution time.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: The user notes a query has high overall latency and asks whether it was delayed due to lock wait time or disk IO time. Once the breakdown is provided, end the conversation. Success Criteria: the assistant queries execution time and lock/IO wait times using get_query_metrics for the specified project and instance. Failure Criteria: the assistant guesses query performance data without calling get_query_metrics.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Users are reporting performance degradation on instance '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_INSTANCE}' in project '${CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_OBSERVABILITY_PROJECT}'. First check if instance CPU or disk IO is maxed out, and then check Query Insights for any runaway queries causing the issue.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 1: Agent checks system metrics for CPU and disk IO. Turn 2: User asks the agent to drill down into Query Insights for queries with high lock wait or execution time during the spike. Turn 3: User asks if there were any deadlock events or connection spikes. Once answered, end the conversation. Success Criteria: the assistant calls both get_system_metrics and get_query_metrics to correlate system load with slow queries and deadlocks. Failure Criteria: the assistant skips either tool or fabricates metrics without querying Cloud Monitoring.
